name: SIM Network
author: chenshifanjian
description: Manage a 4G modem: live data usage and speed, SMS and MMS send/receive with desktop notifications, Obsidian archiving, GPS, and a monthly data-quota check. Built for Quectel EG25-G on China Telecom; receiving MMS needs mmsd-tng. The optional extras/ helpers need python3 + pyserial, a hand-added NOPASSWD sudoers rule limited to systemctl start/stop ModemManager, and one manual request to api64.ipify.org.
